name: validator-vue
description: Vue 3 form validation helpers (useValidator, ErrorMessage, ErrorMessageList) for yup schemas, incl. those generated by murdej/validator.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist && pnpm run copy:components
